name: SmartPress PRO
author: z10g8

sections.description:
SmartPress PRO is your ultimate AI companion for WordPress — built for creators, developers, and site owners who want to write faster, design smarter, and automate everything with powerful AI tools that feel native to WordPress.

🚀 Write. Generate. Automate. All from your dashboard.

Features

1. AI Writing Toolkit
Create long-form articles, SEO content, product descriptions, and more — powered by GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
– Prompt Templates & Smart Variables
– Custom Output Rules (HTML, plain text, etc.)
– Prompt Enhancer with History
– Native support for Elementor, Gutenberg, WooCommerce, Classic Editor & more

2. AI-Powered Image Generation
Generate on-brand visuals instantly — right inside your media library.
– Fine-tune prompts, size, and model
– Auto-upload and insert with one click
– No design skills needed

3. SmartChat AI Assistant
A powerful moderator, creator, and command executor — all in one assistant.
– Publish posts
– Update pages
– Moderate comments
– Perform multi-step actions
– Safe, secure API-based control — your data stays local

4. Seamless Native Integration
SmartPress feels like a natural part of WordPress. It fits everywhere — even in text fields, SEO plugins, and WooCommerce panels.

5. Fully Customizable
Switch features on/off, select models, set limits, and control behavior — all from the SmartPress Control Panel.

Who It’s For

  • Bloggers & Content Creators
  • SEO Pros & Copywriters
  • Designers & WordPress Developers
  • eCommerce Store Owners
  • Agencies & Teams
  • Anyone who wants to do more in less time with WordPress

Privacy Policy

SmartPress does not collect personal data. All interactions happen locally and securely on your own WordPress site.

Support

Join the community or reach out directly:
🧠 Discord Server
📧 Email: smartpress@10g8.com
sections.installation:
1. Search for “Smartpress” in your wordpress plugins page.
  2. Install and Activate “SmartPress” Plugin.
  3. One Click create an account and get started.
sections.faq:
Will this work with my page builder or plugins?

Yes — it’s built to integrate with Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, WooCommerce, and most popular plugins.

Is SmartPress really free to use?

Yes. You can use it with basic models for free. Upgrade to PRO for advanced models and premium features.

Is the SmartChat assistant safe?

100%. Your data stays on your site. SmartChat uses secure APIs with application-level access — no 3rd party exposure.

Can SmartPress manage my site?

Yes. The AI assistant can write posts, update pages, moderate comments, and perform tasks via smart commands.
